The '''Xappyh sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. At least a portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Xappyh included [[Neelgaimon]] and [[Stic/Legends|Stic]].

==History==
[[Jorus C'baoth]] served as [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]-at-large to the sector.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Princess/Legends|princess]] from the Xappyh sector recruited a group of spacers to deal with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who had captured one of her family's outpost.<ref name="SWG:Huiohon">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Help us in our hour of need}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Thanta Zilbra (planet)|Thanta Zilbra]], [[Thila/Legends|Thila]], [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], [[G'rho]], [[Norulac]], and [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] in the Xappyh sector. Thanta Zilbra is in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]; Ambria is in the [[Stenness Node]]; G'rho is on the [[Shiritoku Spur]]; Norulac is in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories; [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] is in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]; and [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] is in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]].
